verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply; overdue setup items are the core blocker.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 8 leads at an average cost of $227.30 per lead — and in the most recent week, leads fell 50% while cost per lead more than doubled compared to the week prior. The primary driver is not ad spend: six agreed milestones (booking automation, intake ownership, profile optimization, and others) remain unresolved, and the vacant dispatch seat means leads that do come in are not being fully worked. Google Business Profile activity has also gone quiet, with zero actions recorded across all three profiles for September 24–26, pulling top-of-funnel volume down further. Heating campaigns and fall creative are due to go live by October 1, and unblocking the overdue milestones is the immediate priority to make that launch count.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days
average cost per lead this period, up from roughly $107 the prior week
agreed setup milestones overdue, ranging from July 31 through September 1

watch_item.issue: All three Google Business Profiles went dark September 24–26 with zero actions, and the 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' profile is converting fewer than 2 in 100 searchers to callers despite steady impressions.
watch_item.fix: Profile optimization is underway this week to strengthen calls-to-action and correct any listing gaps that are suppressing call volume.
